about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Fourth Sunday after Easter” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Be present with us, O Lord our God, that by these things which we have faithfully received we may be cleansed from our faults and delivered from all dangers. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

a.g: by these things which we have faithfully received
in the unity of the Holy Spirit
